pairsWith.noteUz: 'The Giant Squid' hikoyasi lug'ati coursebook 55-bet 5-7-mashqlarga; transport va hayvonlar guruhlari coursebook 54-bet 1-mashqqa mos keladi.

scanNote:
WORKBOOK 8-UNITNING BIRINChI BETI (34-bet). Yuqorida to'q sariq yorliqda 'UNIT 8', yonida katta qora 'A Brush with Danger'.

CHAP USTUN - 'Vocabulary':
1) 'Circle the correct item.' 1 The fisherman had just ...... his fishing line into the water when it started to rain. A pushed B cast C pulled. 2 When I visited Paris, I went on a ...... tour and learnt a lot about the city. A guided B popular C crowded. 3 A: Do you know Dr Smith? B: Yes, I work with him. He is a ...... of mine. A colleague B tourist C scientist. 4 Kim's mother had ...... the laundry by the time she got home from school. A cleaned B gone C done. 5 The boat was damaged in the storm and it ...... to the bottom of the sea. A drown B sank C fell. 6 The breeze gently ...... the small boat from side to side. A rocked B smashed C destroyed. 7 She had ...... the floor before she mopped it. A polished B swept C dusted. 8 Mary was so deep in ...... that she didn't hear her son crying. A search B horror C thought.
2) 'Replace the words in bold with their synonym.' Qiya: 'terrified, quickly, deserted, excitedly, exhausted, desperately'. 1 Katie didn't go to the party because she was tired. 2 Steven ran as fast as he could to the edge of the cliff and grabbed Lee's hand. 3 When Adam couldn't find a way out of the burning house, he started shouting anxiously for help. 4 The sun was shining as Beth and William walked along the empty beach. 5 Carol was scared when she realised a strange man was following her. 6 The crowd screamed wildly when the rock star walked onto the stage.

O'NG USTUN:
3) 'Match the animals in the list to the nouns.' Qiya: 'whales, cows, flies, deer, bees, wasps, dolphins, sheep, elephants, fish, birds'. 1 a school of ...whales,... 2 a herd of ...... 3 a swarm of ...... 4 a flock of ......
4a) 'Which of the following means of transport would you use to travel by land, by sea and by air? Use words from the list to fill in the table.' Qiya: 'hot-air balloon, train, jeep, yacht, motorbike, car, aeroplane, ship, ferry, bicycle, bus, helicopter'. JADVAL: by land / by sea / by air. 4b) 'Which means of transport do most people use in your country?'
5) 'Fill in the correct preposition from the list. One of the prepositions is used twice.' Qiya: 'from, at, for, on, in, of, to'. 1 The brave policeman helped Jeff ...... safety. 2 We searched ...... the torch, but we couldn't find it anywhere because it was too dark. 3 Don't let go ...... the string or your kite will fly away. 4 I feel that I have benefitted greatly ...... working at the summer camp. 5 My grandmother was born in Italy and spent the first years of her life ...... the island of Sicily. 6 Peggy and Sue stopped to have lunch ...... a nice restaurant. 7 When at last a boat appeared ...... the distance we all felt relieved. 8 Nobody believed what he said except ...... his mother.

Bet raqami: pastda chapda '34'.

exercises.explanationUz:
'THE GIANT SQUID' LUG'ATI
  (coursebook 55-bet 5-6-mashqlar).

  cast a fishing line = qarmoq
    tashlamoq
  a guided tour = gid bilan sayohat
  a colleague of mine = hamkasbim
  do the laundry = kir yuvmoq
  sank (sink) = cho'kdi
  rocked from side to side =
    u yoqdan-bu yoqqa tebratdi
  swept the floor (sweep) = polni
    supurdi (keyin 'mopped' - yuvdi)
  deep in thought = o'yga cho'mgan


⚠ 'HAD JUST CAST ... WHEN':

  Past perfect (8-unit
  grammatikasi): 'had cast' -
  yomg'irdan OLDIN.


⚠ 'A COLLEAGUE OF MINE':

  = mening hamkasbim ('a ... of
  mine' qolipi).


⚠ 'SANK' vs 'DROWN':

  sink → sank = cho'kmoq (narsa)
  drown = cho'kib o'lmoq (odam)


⚠ 'SWEEP' vs 'MOP':

  sweep = supurmoq (quruq)
  mop = yuvmoq (ho'l shvabra)
  Avval supuriladi, keyin yuviladi.

items.textEn: The fisherman had just ___ his fishing line into the water when it started to rain.
items.uz: Baliqchi endigina qarmog'ini suvga tashlagan edi, yomg'ir yog'a boshladi.
items.whyUz: ⚠ 'cast a fishing line' - qarmoq tashlamoq (turg'un birikma).

items.textEn: When I visited Paris, I went on a ___ tour and learnt a lot about the city.
items.uz: Parijga borganimda gid bilan sayohatga chiqdim va shahar haqida ko'p narsa bildim.

items.textEn: A: Do you know Dr Smith? B: Yes, I work with him. He is a ___ of mine.
items.uz: Doktor Smitni bilasizmi? - Ha, u bilan ishlayman. U mening hamkasbim.

items.textEn: Kim's mother had ___ the laundry by the time she got home from school.
items.uz: Kim maktabdan uyga kelguncha onasi kir yuvib bo'lgan edi.

items.textEn: The boat was damaged in the storm and it ___ to the bottom of the sea.
items.uz: Qayiq bo'ronda shikastlandi va dengiz tubiga cho'kdi.

items.textEn: The breeze gently ___ the small boat from side to side.
items.uz: Shabada kichik qayiqni ohista u yoqdan-bu yoqqa tebratdi.
items.whyUz: ⚠ 'rock from side to side' = tebratmoq; 'gently' - yumshoq.

items.textEn: She had ___ the floor before she mopped it.
items.uz: U polni yuvishdan oldin supurgan edi.

items.textEn: Mary was so deep in ___ that she didn't hear her son crying.
items.uz: Meri shu qadar o'yga cho'mgan ediki, o'g'lining yig'lashini eshitmadi.

exercises.instructionEn: Replace the words in bold with their synonym: terrified, quickly, deserted, excitedly, exhausted, desperately. 1 tired 2 fast 3 anxiously 4 empty 5 scared 6 wildly
exercises.instructionUz: Qalin harfli so'zlarni sinonimi bilan almashtiring: terrified, quickly, deserted, excitedly, exhausted, desperately. 1 tired 2 fast 3 anxiously 4 empty 5 scared 6 wildly
exercises.explanationUz:
SINONIMLAR (coursebook 55-bet
  5-mashq).

  tired → EXHAUSTED (juda
    charchagan)
  fast → QUICKLY (tez)
  anxiously → DESPERATELY (umidsiz,
    jon holatda)
  empty → DESERTED (kimsasiz)
  scared → TERRIFIED (dahshatga
    tushgan)
  wildly → EXCITEDLY (hayajon
    bilan)

  ⚠ Sinonim - kuchliroq variant:
  tired < exhausted, scared <
  terrified.


⚠ 'DESERTED':

  = kimsasiz, tashlab ketilgan.
  'a deserted beach'.


⚠ 'THE EDGE OF THE CLIFF':

  = qoya cheti.


⚠ 'TO GRAB':

  = shartta ushlamoq.


⚠ 'A WAY OUT':

  = chiqish yo'li.

items.sentence: Katie didn't go to the party because she was tired. → ___
items.uz: Keyti bazmga bormadi, chunki u juda charchagan edi.

items.sentence: Steven ran as fast as he could to the edge of the cliff and grabbed Lee's hand. → ___
items.uz: Stiven iloji boricha tez qoya chetiga yugurib, Lining qo'lidan ushladi.

items.sentence: When Adam couldn't find a way out of the burning house, he started shouting anxiously for help. → ___
items.uz: Adam yonayotgan uydan chiqish yo'lini topolmaganida jon holatda yordam so'rab qichqira boshladi.

items.sentence: The sun was shining as Beth and William walked along the empty beach. → ___
items.uz: Bet va Uilyam kimsasiz plyaj bo'ylab yurganida quyosh porlab turardi.

items.sentence: Carol was scared when she realised a strange man was following her. → ___
items.uz: Kerol notanish odam uni kuzatib kelayotganini anglaganida dahshatga tushdi.

items.sentence: The crowd screamed wildly when the rock star walked onto the stage. → ___
items.uz: Rok yulduzi sahnaga chiqqanida olomon hayajon bilan qichqirdi.

exercises.instructionEn: Match the animals in the list to the nouns: whales, cows, flies, deer, bees, wasps, dolphins, sheep, elephants, fish, birds. 1 a school of ... 2 a herd of ... 3 a swarm of ... 4 a flock of ...
exercises.instructionUz: Ro'yxatdagi hayvonlarni otlarga moslang: whales, cows, flies, deer, bees, wasps, dolphins, sheep, elephants, fish, birds. 1 a school of ... 2 a herd of ... 3 a swarm of ... 4 a flock of ...
exercises.explanationUz:
HAYVON GURUHLARI (collective
  nouns).

  a SCHOOL of - dengiz jonzotlari:
    whales, dolphins, fish
  a HERD of - katta yer hayvonlari:
    cows, deer, elephants
  a SWARM of - hasharotlar:
    flies, bees, wasps
  a FLOCK of - qushlar va qo'ylar:
    birds, sheep


⚠ 'SCHOOL':

  = maktab EMAS - baliqlar galasi!


⚠ KO'PLIK BIR XIL:

  deer → deer, sheep → sheep,
  fish → fish.


⚠ 'A WASP':

  = ari (chaqadigan). 'a bee' =
  asalari.

pairs.whyUz: ⚠ NAMUNA: 'a school of whales'. Dengiz jonzotlari.

exercises.instructionEn: Which of the following means of transport would you use to travel by land, by sea and by air? Use words from the list to fill in the table: hot-air balloon, train, jeep, yacht, motorbike, car, aeroplane, ship, ferry, bicycle, bus, helicopter.
exercises.instructionUz: Quruqlikda, dengizda va havoda sayohat qilish uchun qaysi transport vositalaridan foydalanasiz? Ro'yxatdagi so'zlar bilan jadvalni to'ldiring: hot-air balloon, train, jeep, yacht, motorbike, car, aeroplane, ship, ferry, bicycle, bus, helicopter.
exercises.explanationUz:
TRANSPORT VOSITALARI.

  BY LAND (quruqlik): train, jeep,
    motorbike, car, bicycle, bus
  BY SEA (dengiz): yacht, ship,
    ferry
  BY AIR (havo): hot-air balloon,
    aeroplane, helicopter


⚠ 'BY + TRANSPORT':

  by car, by train, by sea, by air
  - artiklsiz!
  ⚠ Lekin 'ON FOOT' (piyoda).


⚠ 'A YACHT':

  = yaxta. /jɒt/ - 'ch' O'QILMAYDI.


⚠ 'AEROPLANE':

  Brit. (AQSh 'airplane'). Qisqa:
  'plane'.


⚠ 'A JEEP':

  = jip (yo'ltanlamas).

pairs.right: train, jeep, motorbike, car, bicycle, bus
pairs.rightUz: poyezd, jip, mototsikl, mashina, velosiped, avtobus

exercises.instructionEn: Which means of transport do most people use in your country?
exercises.instructionUz: Sizning mamlakatingizda ko'pchilik qaysi transport vositasidan foydalanadi?
exercises.explanationUz:
O'Z FIKRINGIZ.
  QOLIP: 'In my country, most
  people use/travel by ...'

  ⚠ 'means of transport' - birlik
  va ko'plik BIR XIL ('a means',
  'means').

items.en: Which means of transport do most people use in your country?
items.uz: Mamlakatingizda ko'pchilik qaysi transportdan foydalanadi?
items.answerEn: In Uzbekistan, most people travel by bus or by car in the cities. Many people also use the metro in Tashkent, and trains for long journeys.
items.answerUz: O'zbekistonda ko'pchilik shaharlarda avtobus yoki mashinada yuradi. Toshkentda ko'pchilik metrodan, uzoq safarlar uchun poyezddan ham foydalanadi.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the correct preposition from the list. One of the prepositions is used twice: from, at, for, on, in, of, to.
exercises.instructionUz: Ro'yxatdan to'g'ri predlogni qo'ying. Predloglardan biri ikki marta ishlatiladi: from, at, for, on, in, of, to.
exercises.explanationUz:
PREDLOGLAR (coursebook 55-bet
  7-mashq).

  help sb TO safety - xavfsiz joyga
    olib chiqmoq
  search FOR - qidirmoq
  let go OF - qo'yib yubormoq
  benefit FROM - ... dan foyda
    ko'rmoq
  ON the island - orolda
  AT a restaurant - restoranda
  IN the distance - uzoqda
  except FOR - ... dan tashqari

  ⚠ 'FOR' ikki marta: search FOR,
  except FOR.


⚠ 'ON AN ISLAND':

  Orol uchun 'ON' ('in' EMAS).


⚠ 'TO LET GO OF':

  = qo'yib yubormoq (ushlab turgan
  narsani).


⚠ 'A TORCH':

  Brit. = fonar (AQSh 'flashlight').


⚠ 'RELIEVED':

  = yengil tortgan.


⚠ SICILY:

  = Sitsiliya (Italiya oroli).

items.sentence: The brave policeman helped Jeff ___ safety.
items.uz: Jasur politsiyachi Jeffni xavfsiz joyga olib chiqdi.

items.sentence: We searched ___ the torch, but we couldn't find it anywhere because it was too dark.
items.uz: Biz fonarni qidirdik, lekin juda qorong'i bo'lgani uchun hech qayerdan topolmadik.

items.sentence: Don't let go ___ the string or your kite will fly away.
items.uz: Ipni qo'yib yuborma, aks holda varraging uchib ketadi.

items.sentence: I feel that I have benefitted greatly ___ working at the summer camp.
items.uz: Yozgi lagerda ishlashdan katta foyda ko'rganimni his qilaman.

items.sentence: My grandmother was born in Italy and spent the first years of her life ___ the island of Sicily.
items.uz: Buvim Italiyada tug'ilgan va hayotining dastlabki yillarini Sitsiliya orolida o'tkazgan.

items.sentence: Peggy and Sue stopped to have lunch ___ a nice restaurant.
items.uz: Peggi va Syu yaxshi restoranda tushlik qilish uchun to'xtashdi.

items.sentence: When at last a boat appeared ___ the distance we all felt relieved.
items.uz: Nihoyat uzoqda qayiq paydo bo'lganida hammamiz yengil tortdik.

items.sentence: Nobody believed what he said except ___ his mother.
items.uz: Onasidan tashqari hech kim uning gapiga ishonmadi.

patterns.formula: X had just + V3 when Y + V2.
patterns.exampleEn: The fisherman had just cast his line when it started to rain.
patterns.exampleUz: Baliqchi endigina qarmog'ini tashlagan edi, yomg'ir yog'a boshladi.

patterns.exampleEn: We saw a flock of birds and a herd of deer.
patterns.exampleUz: Biz qushlar galasi va bug'ular podasini ko'rdik.

patterns.formula: to travel by land / by sea / by air
patterns.exampleEn: Most people travel by land, but some travel by air.
patterns.exampleUz: Ko'pchilik quruqlikda sayohat qiladi, ba'zilar esa havoda.

patterns.formula: X was so + SIFAT + that + GAP.
patterns.exampleEn: Mary was so deep in thought that she didn't hear her son.
patterns.exampleUz: Meri shu qadar o'yga cho'mgan ediki, o'g'lini eshitmadi.
